rationale: The packet positively establishes all three obligation values and answers the demanded question. In the Outfall 001 – Intermittent Flow discharge limitations table, the Total Dissolved Solids row lists Report (not numeric values) in MONTHLY AVG, DAILY MAX, MONTHLY AVG, and DAILY MAX, contrasted in the same table with parameters that carry numeric limits (e.g., Total Suspended Solids 20/30 mg/l). That table text establishes report-only discharge characterization without numeric compliance comparison for TDS at this outfall. The monitoring frequency for TDS is 1/Quarter (*1), and footnote *1 explicitly reads When discharging, grounding the conditioning of the grab monitoring requirement on discharge occurrence. No contradictory limit or unconditioned monitoring language appears in the packet. The proposition is therefore supported by direct permit text rather than inferred from absence.
